algorithm: {The proposed algorithm is a hybrid of Differential Evolution (DE) and Simulated Annealing (SA), combining the exploration-exploitation trade-off from DE with the temperature schedule of SA to efficiently explore the search space and converge to the global minimum.}

{ This implementation uses a hybrid of Simulated Annealing (SA) and Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), incorporating SA's ability to escape local minima with SGD's efficiency in exploiting the gradient information. }
